Nothing should look or behave differently in this release: it reorganizes how Parley is built inside so new features — another transcription provider, another start path — are quicker and safer to add. Everything you use today works as it did in 0.34.1.

**Under the hood** (#611, #612, #613, #614)

- Transcription providers are described in one place on each side of the app, so adding one no longer means touching a dozen files.
- Meetings, voice typing and uploaded recordings share one start check and one set of error messages.
- The app's internal command and event contract is written down once and typed.
- The largest files (the MCP server, voice typing, settings, the app state) are split into smaller, tested modules. The test suite grew by about 220 tests.
- An error code that happened to match a built-in JavaScript name no longer shows a broken message.
- Windows developers can build Parley in debug mode again (a C runtime mismatch stopped the link).
